messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "when changing from immediate-release to extended-release metoprolol, the same total daily dose is used"
set: ["when changing from immediate-release to extended-release metoprolol, the same total daily dose is used", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form", "immediate-release tablets are used", "if switched from tablets to extended-release capsules (Coreg CR), daily total dose may be higher or lower than before", "this may happen when switching from tablets to extended-release capsules", "used when needed", "extended-release capsules are taken once daily at about the same time each day", "low starting dose is generally used", "consider dose reduction when used with bupropion", "total amount you take in a day stays the same", "drowsiness may go away when the dose is lowered", "may be repeated at the same dose", "registry is used to track the effects of methylphenidate on the baby", "Patients may be switched to the extended-release 450 mg dose", "lowest dose that works is used long term", "if the full intravenous dose was not tolerated, 25 mg is used"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
